nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3 Recast
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

**Recast** puts another person into a shot and keeps the shot: its place, camera, timing, motion and sound stay; only the people change.

It follows [H3 Recast](https://github.com/Bambushu/h3-recast) by Bambushu (MIT) and the [BFS character swap LoRA](https://civitai.com/models/2027766?modelVersionId=3401556) by NRDX:

- **Clip** is pinned as a guide over its whole length, with its sound (`MiniMaxH3AddGuide`). It is cut to whole H3 blocks (17n+5 frames at 24 fps)
- **Scene reference** is one frame of the clip with everyone in their new look. Without one, Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 makes it: it puts the **Character** picture into the clip's first frame
- **Person 1-3**, left to right as they stand in the clip, one line each: `the woman in the red dress becomes a woman with short platinum hair in a green dress`. *becomes* (or *turns into*, `->`, `=`) splits who they are from their new look. Give everyone in the shot a line, also those who stay as they are; a person left out gets re-dressed

**What comes from where**: motion, hands, lips and the set come from the clip; faces, hair, bodies and clothes from the scene reference. Big changes land; subtle ones fall back to the clip.

**In Spool** the clip and the character come from the inspector, and Spool leaves the scene reference out when it is empty. Opened in ComfyUI on its own, choose a scene reference, or set **Boolean (Use the scene reference)** to false and delete the Scene reference node.

nodes.title: Note: The caption
widgets_values:
## The caption

The swap LoRA was trained on one caption (`body_swap: ...`) for one, two or three people. The person lines fill it in: the part before *becomes* is who they are in the clip, the part after is their new look. Empty lines count the people, which picks the caption.
